verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official CLI. It installs with `npm install -g @angular/cli`, `ng new` creates a new workspace, and `ng serve` builds and serves the app with rebuilds on file changes. The repo promises "Get started in 5 minutes", and an in-browser option exists for trying Angular without setup. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scaffold-to-running takes only a few minutes.
